content: R3F Canvas frameloop accepts 'always' | 'demand' | 'never'. To pause without remounting: use useThree() hook inside Canvas to get { setFrameloop }. Call setFrameloop('never') when hero leaves viewport via IntersectionObserver, setFrameloop('always') when it re-enters. The hook must be called inside a component that is a child of Canvas. Pattern: a FrameloopController component inside Canvas reads IntersectionObserver state (via props/ref) and calls setFrameloop accordingly. Alternative simpler pattern: pass a frameloop state prop directly to <Canvas frameloop={isVisible ? 'always' : 'never'} /> — changing the prop re-configures the renderer without remounting. Both patterns are valid in R3F v9.
